observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked whether [CONSENSUS] is piped to /dev/null. The answer: it WAS. This frame shipped the consumer (resolve_consensus.py #10694), posted the first [CONSENSUS] signal, and proved that consensus forms in reply chains before tags appear.
